evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic parameters of voriconazole after doses of 10 to 80 mg/kg by oral gavage
S03 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.00606-10 | Table 2 (checked against the PDF)

Female CD-1 mice 20-22 g, 4-5 weeks, NON-neutropenic; disseminated aspergillosis (A. fumigatus AZN 8196 i.v.). Voriconazole oral solution by gavage once daily, 10, 40 or 80 mg/kg, from 24 h after infection. PK blood sampled on DAY 2 OF TREATMENT (methods: "immediately before administration of voriconazole and at 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, and 24 h postdosing"; text: "8 time points"), 3 mice per time point, lithium-heparin plasma, HPLC-fluorescence, LLOQ 0.01 mg/liter for low concentrations.

No footnotes. The fAUC column unit is printed as "mg·h/liter·kg", the same as the dose-normalized AUC column. Text: "The AUC normalized to a dose of 10 mg/kg resulted in ratios of 0.31, 1.75, and 3.68"; "Clearance decreased with increasing doses, showing nonlinearity."

Unbound fraction by ultrafiltration of pooled 1, 2, 4 h plasma (n = 3 per dosing arm): "26.51%, 33.28%, and 30.59% for the 10-, 40-, and 80-mg/kg groups"; "geometric mean unbound voriconazole fraction for all groups combined (n = 9) was 29.97% (95% confidence interval [95% CI], 27.56 to 32.59%)". Discussion: "29.87% (standard deviation, 2.9%)".

findings.reason: A20 explicitly preserves the fAUC unit mg·h/liter·kg, also printed for Dose-normalized AUC. A20 describes normalization to 10 mg/kg and calls 0.31, 1.75 and 3.68 ratios, while C23:C25 repeat those numbers under a unit-bearing header. The definitions and normalization denominator remain unresolved; no unit or value has been corrected.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported definitions of fAUC and dose-normalized AUC, their normalization denominator, printed-unit interpretation and any documented correction. Review the repeated note/table values without selecting an interpretation.

findings.reason: A19 quotes immediately before administration and a postdosing schedule including 0 h, while separately quoting 8 time points. The relationship between predose and 0 h and the intended sampling count are not resolved. Three mice per time point does not establish serial animal identity.
findings.needed_material: Clarification of the predose/0 h relationship and source sampling schedule; preserve both descriptions and avoid inventing animals or sampling events.

findings.reason: A21 reports a combined geometric mean unbound fraction of 29.97% with a 95% confidence interval, then quotes Discussion: 29.87% with standard deviation 2.9%. Their statistical definitions differ and the relationship between the two central values is unresolved. Neither is adopted or averaged.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported clarification of the Discussion value, its population and statistic, and its relationship to the combined geometric mean. Retain both original statements for review.

findings.reason: MI004 remains OPEN with status CONFLICT, needed_at pk: conflicting mouse binding sources and percentage interpretation prevent selection of a single defensible mouse free-exposure conversion. A21 provides source-specific plasma unbound percentages measured by ultrafiltration; it does not resolve the inherited serum/plasma/secondary-table conflict or establish interchangeability across contexts.
findings.needed_material: At the animal PK phase, resolve source-specific binding definitions and applicability, retaining unresolved alternatives under SC031 rather than averaging them. Preserve the original MI004 record and its origin.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: A21 supplies mouse plasma unbound percentages, ultrafiltration, pooled 1, 2 and 4 h samples, arm-specific results and sample counts. Measurement temperature, pH, tested concentration range, recovery, nonspecific binding and mass balance are NOT_FOUND. Direct measured unbound concentration records are not present on this page. Binding conversion applicability is unestablished.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked binding conditions and concentration range, any reported recovery/nonspecific-binding/mass-balance information, and an applicability assessment for the intended free-exposure inputs. Blood/plasma partition information is conditional on an intended basis change.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: A19 and A23:A25 establish three dose groups, once-daily oral dosing, treatment initiation relative to infection and day-2 sampling; the table supplies dose-specific reported parameters. Actual concentration-time records, complete prior dosing events, individual identifiers, single-versus-repeat-dose contrasts and parameter-estimation methods are NOT_FOUND on this page. The source statement that clearance decreased with dose is a reported conclusion, not a completed model assessment.
findings.needed_material: Retain these dose/day-specific parameters as candidate evidence. Obtain authorized concentration-time records and dosing/design metadata before assessing nonlinear or time-dependent model support; do not transfer parameters across doses or days.

findings.reason: MI006 remains OPEN with status DEFERRED, needed_at pk: animal PK model support and design-permitted evaluation have not been assessed. This page supplies reported parameters and design notes but cannot determine supported mouse or rat model structures, identifiability or permitted predictive checks.
findings.needed_material: At the animal PK phase, assess the prepared evidence for the conditional choices in SC022 and retain unsupported or unassessable components as limitations. Preserve the original MI006 record and its origin.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: This page supplies mouse dose/day-specific reported parameters, a study weight range, infection state and binding evidence relevant to DRQ012 and DRQ013. It supplies no qualified animal model outputs, individual study weights, metabolic-clearance evidence, physiological translation relationships or species-inclusion comparison. It cannot qualify a parameter, species or human prediction.
findings.needed_material: Reuse these source-linked candidate definitions and review statuses. Obtain supported upstream model outputs and only the additional body-size, binding, clearance and physiological inputs needed by explicitly considered translation approaches.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: B23:B25 and D23:D25 supply reported AUC and fAUC values by dose. The AUC integration window and origin, explicit fAUC definition and derivation, applicable free-exposure conversion, matched isolate MIC and response records are NOT_FOUND. Printed fAUC units also require review.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported exposure definitions and windows, resolved unit interpretation, binding applicability, and matched isolate MIC/response evidence before fAUC/MIC comparison.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: G23:G25 supply source-reported dose-group Cmax values in mg/liter and H23:H25 supply Tmax. findings.needed_material: Source-supported peak definition, concentration basis and window, justified free-exposure inputs, and matched isolate MIC and endpoint-specific response evidence.
